name: Can I replace the anode rod myself, or should I hire a professional plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace the anode rod myself, or should I hire a professional plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is technically possible for a homeowner with the right tools and knowledge to replace an anode rod, it is often best left to a professional plumber. The process involves draining the water heater, loosening potentially seized fittings, and proper re-sealing to prevent leaks. Attempting this without experience can lead to leaks, damage to the water heater, or injury. CG Plumbing Solutions technicians are experienced in these replacements, ensuring the job is done correctly and safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing an anode rod requires specific tools and plumbing knowledge; it's generally safer and more effective to hire a professional plumber to avoid damage or leaks.
